js: (async () => { const G = window.G, p = G.player; G.opts.god = false; p.hp = 100; p.money = 200; p.wanted = 1; p.wantedTimer = 15; let h = null; for (let i = 0; i < 8 && !h; i++) { const a = i * Math.PI / 4; h = G.spawnOfficer({ position: { x: p.pos.x + Math.cos(a) * 4, z: p.pos.z + Math.sin(a) * 4 }, userData: { heading: a + Math.PI } }); } const r = { beamter: !!h, schuesse: 0, zielt: false, fest: false }; for (let i = 0; i < 100 && p.wanted > 0 && !p.dead; i++) { await new Promise(q => setTimeout(q, 500)); for (const c of G.peds) if (c.userData.state === 'cop') { r.schuesse = Math.max(r.schuesse, c.userData.shots || 0); if (c.userData.aiming) r.zielt = true; } if (p.bustedT > 0) r.fest = true; } Object.assign(r, { wanted: p.wanted, hp: p.hp, geld: p.money, tot: p.dead }); window.__pf1 = r; return JSON.stringify(r); })()
expect: (() => { const r = window.__pf1; return !!r && r.beamter && !r.tot && r.hp >= 80 && r.schuesse === 0 && !r.zielt && r.wanted === 0 && r.geld >= 165 && r.geld <= 172; })()

js: (async () => { const G = window.G, p = G.player; p.hp = 100; p.money = 200; p.wanted = 1; p.wantedTimer = 15; const r = { schuesse: 0, zielt: false, fest: false, streife: 0, beamte: 0 }; for (let i = 0; i < 90 && p.wanted > 0 && !p.dead; i++) { await new Promise(q => setTimeout(q, 500)); r.streife = Math.max(r.streife, G.cars.filter(c => c.userData.mode === 'police').length); let n = 0; for (const c of G.peds) if (c.userData.state === 'cop') { n++; r.schuesse = Math.max(r.schuesse, c.userData.shots || 0); if (c.userData.aiming) r.zielt = true; } r.beamte = Math.max(r.beamte, n); if (p.bustedT > 0) r.fest = true; } Object.assign(r, { wanted: +p.wanted.toFixed(2), hp: p.hp, geld: p.money, tot: p.dead }); window.__pf2 = r; return JSON.stringify(r); })()
expect: (() => { const r = window.__pf2; return !!r && !r.tot && r.schuesse === 0 && !r.zielt && r.hp >= 80; })()

js: (() => { const G = window.G, p = G.player; p.wanted = 0.5; p.wantedTimer = 15; p.money = 200; p.hp = -50; return 'hp0'; })()

(async () => { const G = window.G, p = G.player; const tot = p.dead; G.keys.Enter = true; await new Promise(q => setTimeout(q, 1500)); G.keys.Enter = false; window.__pf3 = { tot, lebt: !p.dead, hp: p.hp, geld: p.money, wanted: p.wanted }; return JSON.stringify(window.__pf3); })()
expect: (() => { const r = window.__pf3; return !!r && r.tot && r.lebt && r.hp === 100 && r.wanted === 0 && r.geld >= 165 && r.geld <= 172; })()
